name: Bangladesh National Cadet Corps (BNCC)
description: Served as a cadet with the 2 Mohastan Battalion while at Rangpur Zilla School. Named Second Best Cadet in the battalion, completed the Primary, Annual and Central Training Exercises (including the 2012 Central Training Exercise), and was shortlisted for the BNCC Sri Lanka tour. Built discipline, leadership and teamwork through structured training.

name: BAUST Career Club
associatedWith: Bangladesh Army University of Science and Technology (BAUST)
description: Member of the university career development club. Took part in career-development programmes, workshops and networking events, and helped organise career-focused activities for students.

name: BAUST Programming Club
associatedWith: Bangladesh Army University of Science and Technology (BAUST)
description: Member of the university competitive programming club. Took part in programming contests, coding practice sessions and technical workshops, strengthening problem-solving with algorithms and data structures.
